title: Fox and the Faded Portrait
description: A realistic fox stands in a dilapidated classical room, looking toward a large cracked portrait of a bald, pale child with large dark eyes. On the dusty floor lie withered roses, a broken teacup, scattered papers, and a glowing purple hexagonal device.
prompt: A realistic fox with detailed fur stands in a decaying ornate room with peeling walls and gilded panels, illuminated by a single wall sconce. In the background leans a large heavily cracked portrait of a bald child with enormous haunting eyes and pale skin. On the floor are withered black roses, a broken teacup, old papers, and a glowing purple hexagonal magical device emitting light. Dark surreal atmosphere, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
